description: Ministry of Labour - Special Allowance payable to workers in the Cocoa, Cardamom and Pepper Growing and Manufacturing Trade
reasoning: This gazette content contains a legal notification issued under the Wages Boards Ordinance (Chapter 136), specifically announcing special allowance rates for workers in the cocoa, cardamom and pepper trade based on cost of living index numbers.
